evals.prompt: Adapt the explicitly named skill plugins/example/skills/deploy-helper for AI Assistant Harness Adaptation so it renders correctly for Claude Code and Codex.
evals.expected_output: Resolves or asks for the explicitly named skill path, inspects only files that enter invocation context, replaces mapped-mechanism callable names with action-map lookups such as {{ actions.AskUser | call }} and skill invocations with {{ "plugin-name:skill-name" | call }}, uses harness conditionals only for genuinely divergent narrative, wraps literal brace output in raw blocks, renames the file with the .j2 suffix leaving no plain sibling, deletes baseline tool coaching instead of templating it, changes no unrelated skill, renders both harness trees, and reports the exact files changed with verification commands run.

assertions.name: requires_explicit_target
assertions.check: response resolves or asks for the explicitly named target skill and changes only it

assertions.name: uses_action_map
assertions.check: callable names come from action-map lookups or the call wrapper filter, never hardcoded literals

assertions.name: conditionals_for_narrative_only
assertions.check: harness conditionals carry only divergent narrative and never select callable names

assertions.name: template_file_rules
assertions.check: output uses the .j2 suffix with no plain/template collision

evals.prompt: Look up the CreateAgent action for Codex from this skill's assistant harness action matrix.
evals.expected_output: Loads references/harness-action-matrix.json or runs scripts/lookup_harness_action.py, resolves matrix actions CreateAgent Codex, and reports the callable name spawn_agent with the wrapped invocation $spawn_agent.

assertions.name: action_first_lookup
assertions.check: lookup goes action-first then assistant and returns the single callable name

assertions.name: wrapped_invocation
assertions.check: reports the invocation wrapper applied to the resolved name

evals.prompt: Make all skills in this repository harness-agnostic.
evals.expected_output: Declines to batch-migrate and asks the user to name one explicit target skill, because this skill adapts only an explicitly named target unless the user explicitly requests a broader migration.

assertions.name: no_unrequested_batch_migration
assertions.check: asks for one explicitly named target instead of migrating every skill

evals.prompt: The target skill needs a new shared mechanism: opening a browser page. The action matrix has no such action.
evals.expected_output: Adds a new TitleCase action to the action matrix first with a callable flag and exactly one name per assistant, keeping the wrapper stored once per assistant and lookup_order action then assistant, then references it from the template via the actions map.

assertions.name: matrix_first
assertions.check: extends the matrix before templating instead of hardcoding a callable name

assertions.name: matrix_contract_kept
assertions.check: new action keeps TitleCase key, callable flag, one name per assistant, and the per-assistant wrapper
